terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1_body: By using Fleetly, you accept that the system accesses your real-time location while the vehicle is reserved. You agree to use the fleet following current traffic regulations.
terms.section2_body_highlight: Fleetly is not responsible for damages, accidents, or infractions resulting from misuse of the vehicle, speeding, or reckless driving by the user.
terms.section2_body: The user is solely responsible for any administrative penalty or damage to third parties during their booking period.
terms.section3_body: You accept that administrators may monitor speed, RPM, and engine status. In emergency cases or misuse detected by telemetry, Fleetly reserves the right to stop the engine remotely once the vehicle is immobilized.
terms.section4_item2: Do not allow unregistered third parties to use the vehicle.
terms.section4_item3: Finish the trip correctly in the app to avoid additional charges.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Fleetly, we take data privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect and process your information.
privacy.section1_body: We collect registration data (name, email, user) and vehicle telemetry data (GPS location, speed, engine status) while you use the service.
privacy.section2_item4: Comply with legal requirements from authorities in case of accident.
privacy.section3_body: We do not sell your data. We only share information with payment providers, judicial authorities (when required), and your organization administrator (tenant).
privacy.section4_body: You may request access, rectification, or deletion of your personal data through the support portal or by emailing privacidad@fleetly.com.
